test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Pausity."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"pausity"** is not a correct spelling. • The correct spelling is** "paucity",** which means scarcity or shortage. ((संख्या या गुणवत्ता) पर्याप्त से कम; थोड़ा, कुछ, कम) • **Example**: *The authorities had to cope with the **paucity**__ of information about the effects of the storm.* • The incorrect spelling can be identified by comparing it to the correct spelling and noticing the swapped letters. • The correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Philanthropy"** is the correct spelling and means the desire to promote the welfare of others, usually through charitable donations or actions. (दान आदि के द्वारा ज़रूरतमंदों की सहायता; परोपकार, लोकोपकार) • **Option 2: "Philistine"** is the correct spelling and can refer to someone who is indifferent to culture and the arts, or a member of an ancient people who were enemies of the Israelites. (कला, साहित्य, संगीत आदि के सौंदर्य को न समझनेवाला; संस्कारशून्य व्यक्ति; अशिक्षित मनुष्य) • **Option 3: "Phlegmatic"** is the correct spelling and describes someone who is calm and unemotional, especially in difficult situations. (जल्‍दी क्रोध में न आने वाला; शांतचित्त) 41:T997, The correct answer is **"installed wood."**
